description: This file contains functions for retrieving and processing transaction lists related to contacts and web forms in the ERPNext system, including handling permissions, filtering, and post-processing of transaction data.

methods.name: get_list_context
methods.description: Provides context data for listing transactions, including formatting and currency info.

methods.name: get_webform_list_context
methods.description: Returns a context with a list retrieval function for webforms, specific to the 'erpnext' app.

methods.name: get_webform_transaction_list
methods.description: Retrieves a list of transactions for custom doctypes, filtering based on linked documents.

methods.name: get_transaction_list
methods.description: Fetches a list of transactions with filtering based on user permissions and document status.

methods.name: get_list_for_transactions
methods.description: Retrieves transactions like invoices and orders, with optional text search and filtering.

methods.name: rfq_transaction_list
methods.description: Fetches RFQ-related transactions with specific filtering.

methods.name: post_process
methods.description: Enhances transaction data with status and item previews, and sets indicators.

methods.name: get_customers_suppliers
methods.description: Determines customers and suppliers linked to a user and doctype.

methods.name: has_website_permission
methods.description: Checks if a user has permission to view a specific document based on linked customers or suppliers.

methods.name: get_customer_filter
methods.description: Creates filters for documents based on associated customers or suppliers.

methods.name: get_customer_field_name
methods.description: Returns the appropriate customer field name for a doctype.
